name: Sequence query returns at most the default size of matches

body.query: EQL eql_pairs "sequence by pid [process where true] [network where true]" | STATS events = COUNT(*), sequences = COUNT_DISTINCT(_sequence)

headers.warning: 299 Elasticsearch-9.7.0-a5b0a6a357d51e992af8cbfac67416041027d0d7 "No limit defined, adding default limit of [1000]", 299 Elasticsearch-9.7.0-a5b0a6a357d51e992af8cbfac67416041027d0d7 "Line 1:1: EQL query used the default size of [10] matches. Set WITH {\"size\": n} to return more."
